description:

Data for a given candle will be considered finalized once the next candle appears on the specified graph. The last trading day of a given week will be considered finalized once the market closes on that day, typically at 5 PM ET on Friday.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on information from the “H” figure located at the top of the EUR/USD Streaming Chart on Investing.com for the specified currency pair (e.g., https://www.investing.com/currencies/eur-usd-chart).

eventMetadata.context_description: Monetary policy convergence between the ECB and Fed stands as the dominant driver of EUR/USD positioning, with the ECB's June 2026 deposit rate hike to 2.25%—its first since 2023—responding to Middle East-driven energy inflation, while the new Fed leadership has held rates steady amid resilient U.S. growth. This narrowing interest rate differential has pressured the euro toward recent levels near 1.14, reinforced by the July 1 U.S.-EU trade agreement capping tariffs at 15%. Traders monitor upcoming ECB and FOMC decisions, eurozone CPI releases, and U.S. nonfarm payrolls for shifts in implied rate paths that could influence year-end moves, with market-implied odds reflecting capital-weighted assessments of these data-dependent outcomes rather than certainties.
